name: Tanzania
summary: A yellow-edged black diagonal band from lower hoist to upper fly, dividing green and light blue triangles. It combines the flags of Tanganyika and Zanzibar, which united in 1964.
origin: Tanganyika became independent in 1961 with a green flag with a black, yellow-edged horizontal band. Zanzibar's 1964 revolutionary flag was blue, black and green.
When the two united as the United Republic of Tanganyika and Zanzibar (renamed Tanzania), a new flag combined both, adopted on 30 June 1964.

facts: The country's name combines Tanganyika and Zanzibar.
The Democratic Republic of the Congo's flag also has a diagonal band, in red with yellow edges.
Zanzibar still flies its own flag, which has Tanzania's flag in the canton.
clues: A black diagonal band edged in yellow, between green and light blue triangles.
It merges the flags of two states that united in 1964.
Its country's name is a blend of two names.
